selection: maximum common internal dev raw NER micro F1; first checkpoint wins ties
D1: Frozen historical V1 train, original tokenizer; no overlay applied
D3: New authored synthetic oral cases only; never real voice
D4: Full documentary plus authored oral, natural sampling
D4W: Same mixed corpus, oral observations twice per epoch; compensate documentary length
test_policy: Internal known-document holdout, evaluated once after every checkpoint is selected; no V1 test predictions
known_dev: 27 historical synthetic dev observations reported separately, never training data
